build_probe_model: build a PyTorch model probe using AutoProbeD to log activations and gradients during forward and backward passes
create_log_stats: create a custom tensor logging call using log_stats to track specific intermediate activations in a model
test_probe_context: test the AutoProbeD context manager to capture linear layer inputs, outputs, weights, and gradients as JSON
review_attention_stats: review the attention logit and entropy statistics computed by _compute_attn_stats_sdpa for SDPA or flash attention backends
summarize_get_stats: summarize the tensor statistics computed by _get_stats including mean, std, skew, kurtosis, and quantiles
